notes: Benchmarks are synthesized from creator-platform analyses (Reelbase, Sydium/Sprout Social citations, Slidy, Contents Pilot, UseVisuals via Creatorflow), Mosseri ranking statements, and JM text-overlay research (Farace et al. 2025; TIR studies).
Treat ranges as operating bands, not universal constants. Optimize against your own Saves/1k reach and Completion.

skeletons.name: Listicle / Reference Dump
skeletons.description: Numbered utility list optimized for Saves. Dense reference value; each body slide = one stealable item.

native_ad_slot.rule: After 3–4 free high-value items, insert product as 'the tool that compresses steps 1–4' — never as first payoff.

skeletons.name: Mistake / Myth Bust
skeletons.description: Error→correction arc. High CTR on hook via named failure; Shares when the correction is counterintuitive.

native_ad_slot.rule: After myth is destroyed, product appears as the 'correct protocol', not a sponsor logo dump.

skeletons.name: Before / After Transformation
skeletons.description: Visual gap on slide 1, withheld after until mid/late. Highest completion among story arcs when after is delayed.

native_ad_slot.rule: Product sits between 'before pain' and 'after reveal' as the method, then after image pays off.

skeletons.name: Personal Burnout / Confession Arc
skeletons.description: Identity + vulnerability hook → escalating stakes → lesson → soft product. Strong comments; Shares when lesson is transferable.

native_ad_slot.rule: Product is the artifact born from the burnout lesson (template, course, tool), introduced after emotional peak.

skeletons.name: Framework / Operating System
skeletons.description: Named system (3–5 steps). Highest Save density when framework is proprietary-feeling and screenshotable.

native_ad_slot.rule: Insert product as Step 0 (setup) or as the accelerator between Step 3 and 4 after core free steps are delivered.

slides.trigger_example: The 4-layer carousel OS I use weekly
